9	/-!
10	# The chart trace is what no-leak really asks for
11	
12	The certificate assemblers consume, per piece `j`, the fibrewise no-leak clause, which is
13	emptiness of the leak locus, which is closedness of the piece trace
14	`supportLocus ∩ pieces j` (`isClosed_supportLocus_inter_iff_supportLeak_eq_empty`), which
15	is clopen-ness of that trace inside the support (`isClopen_trace_of_supportLeak_eq_empty`).
16	
17	This file records the consequence that had been missed for the whole lifetime of the lane:
18	**the per-piece clause cannot be produced piece by piece.**  A `FinCoverData` carries a
19	partition of unity on each pinned chart, so the chart-`b` pieces cover the *whole* pinned
20	chart `V_b` — hence the union of their traces is the whole chart trace
21	`supportLocus ∩ V_b`.  A finite union of closed sets is closed, so
22	
23	> no-leak at every chart-`b` piece **forces** `supportLocus ∩ V_b` to be closed in the
24	> relative curve, i.e. the chart trace to be clopen in the support.
25	
26	That is a property of the *system and the pinned charts alone*: no choice of adaptation, and
27	no shrinking of the base, can produce no-leak for a system whose chart trace is not closed.
28	It is therefore the honest gate of the lane, and it replaces the refuted `tube-fibre`
29	framing (put the support inside one piece — impossible once the support meets both charts,
30	`not_exists_unique_support_piece`) and the refuted separated framing
31	(`DivSchemeCertZarSep.lean`) with a single geometric statement about the divisor.
32	
33	Read positively, it also says where to aim: `supportLocus ∩ V₀` and `supportLocus ∩ V₁`
34	closed is not merely necessary, it is *sufficient*, because the two-piece adaptation whose
35	pieces are the pinned charts themselves realizes it (`DivSchemeCertZarChartPair.lean`).
36	
37	## Main declarations
38	
39	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation.supportLocus_inter_chart₀_eq_iUnion` /
40	  `…_chart₁_…` — the chart trace is the finite union of the chart's piece traces.
41	* `DivisorAdaptation.isClosed_supportLocus_inter_chart₀_of_forall_supportLeak_eq_empty`
42	  and its chart-1 twin — no-leak at every piece of a chart forces the chart trace closed.
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation.isClosed_supportLocus_inter_chart_of_forall_noLeak` —
44	  the assembler-shaped form: the `hnoLeak` hypothesis of
45	  `isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning` forces both chart traces closed.
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation.not_forall_noLeak_of_not_isClosed_chart₀` — the
47	  obstruction, contrapositive: a system with a non-closed chart-0 trace admits **no**
48	  adaptation satisfying the assembler's no-leak clause.
49	-/

78	    d.supportLocus ∩ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R))
79	      = ⋃ j : Fin A.m₀, d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces (Sum.inl j) : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
80	  apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
81	  · rintro x ⟨hxs, hxV⟩
82	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (A.toFinCoverData.cover₀ hxV)
83	    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hxs, hj⟩
84	  · refine Set.iUnion_subset fun j x hx => ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
85	    exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (A.h₀ j) hx.2

92	  · rintro x ⟨hxs, hxV⟩
93	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (A.toFinCoverData.cover₁ hxV)
94	    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hxs, hj⟩
95	  · refine Set.iUnion_subset fun j x hx => ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩

128	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
129	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
130	        (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) :

132	        ∩ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
133	      ∧ IsClosed (d.supportLocus
134	        ∩ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R))) := by
135	  have hleak : ∀ j : A.index, d.supportLeak (A.pieces j) = ∅ := fun j =>

138	  exact ⟨A.isClosed_supportLocus_inter_chart₀_of_forall_supportLeak_eq_empty

143	/-! ## The obstruction
144	
145	The contrapositive is the statement the lane needed: for a system whose chart trace is not
146	closed there is *nothing to prove* — the assembler's hypothesis is false for every
147	adaptation, so no support-tube refinement, no idempotent packet extraction and no shrinking
148	of the base can supply it.  The tube mechanism (`exists_basicOpen_supportLeak_eq_empty`)
149	is not a counterexample: it shrinks the base, and shrinking the base shrinks the system's
150	support too, so what it proves is the chart-trace statement over the smaller base. -/
151	
152	/-- **The obstruction.** If the chart-0 trace of the system is not closed in the relative
153	curve, then no adaptation of that system satisfies the assembler's no-leak clause. -/
154	theorem not_forall_noLeak_of_not_isClosed_chart₀
155	    (hnc : ¬ IsClosed (d.supportLocus
156	      ∩ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))) :
157	    ¬ ∀ (j : A.index) (s : Spec (.of R)),
158	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
159	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
160	        (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
161	  fun h => hnc (A.isClosed_supportLocus_inter_chart_of_forall_noLeak h).1
162	
163	/-- **The obstruction, chart 1.** -/
164	theorem not_forall_noLeak_of_not_isClosed_chart₁
165	    (hnc : ¬ IsClosed (d.supportLocus
166	      ∩ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R)))) :
167	    ¬ ∀ (j : A.index) (s : Spec (.of R)),
168	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
169	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
170	        (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
171	  fun h => hnc (A.isClosed_supportLocus_inter_chart_of_forall_noLeak h).2

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyTheta
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RigidEngine4Relative

9	/-!
10	# DDR-3 infrastructure — flatness of chart sections and side-uniform theta components
11	
12	The substrate of the relative local-generator construction
13	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeFamily`, `informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 3):
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.flat_sections_basicOpen` — flatness of a section ring over the base
16	  descends to basic opens (`IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_basicOpen` + localization
17	  flatness + `Module.Flat.trans`);
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.sections_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_germ`,
19	  `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_unit_mul_of_mutual_dvd` — germwise regularity gives
20	  section-level regularity, and mutual divisibility against a regular section is a unit
21	  ratio (the ratio-unit engine);
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPinnedChart`, `flat_sections_relPinnedChart` — the two pinned
23	  charts of the relative curve indexed by a `Bool` side, with the free-base-change
24	  flatness `Γ(C_R, Vᵢᴿ) = R ⊗[k] Γ(C, Vᵢ)` (`free_relSections`);
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relThetaResSide`, `relThetaSideUnit`, `relThetaResSide_matching` —
26	  the side-uniform chart components of a global theta section (`relThetaResFst/Snd`
27	  packaged over the side index) and their matching through the theta cocycle.
28	-/
29	
30	set_option autoImplicit false
31	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
32	
33	universe u
34	
35	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
36	open scoped TensorProduct
37	
38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
39	
40	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
41	
42	/-! ## The flatness ladder: section rings of basic opens are flat over the test ring -/
43	
44	section BasicOpenFlat
45	
46	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of K))]
47	
48	/-- **Flatness descends to basic opens**: for an affine open `V` with `Γ(X, V)` flat over
49	the base ring `K`, the section ring of any basic open `D(f) ⊆ V` is flat over `K` —
50	`Γ(X, D(f))` is a localization of `Γ(X, V)` (`IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_basicOpen`),
51	localizations are flat, and flatness composes along the scalar tower
52	`K → Γ(X, V) → Γ(X, D(f))`. -/
53	theorem flat_sections_basicOpen {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
54	    (hflat : Module.Flat K Γ(X, V)) (f : Γ(X, V)) :
55	    Module.Flat K Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) := by
56	  haveI := hflat
57	  haveI := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen f
58	  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(X, V) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :=
59	    IsLocalization.flat _ (Submonoid.powers f)
60	  haveI : IsScalarTower K Γ(X, V) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :=
61	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r =>
62	      (X.overAlgebraMap_apply_res K (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op r).symm
63	  exact Module.Flat.trans K Γ(X, V) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)
64	
65	end BasicOpenFlat
66	
67	/-! ## Section-level and unit-ratio consequences of germwise regularity -/
68	
69	section GermRegular
70	
71	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
72	
73	/-- A section all of whose germs are nonzerodivisors is a nonzerodivisor
74	(sections of a sheaf inject into the product of their germs). -/
75	theorem sections_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_germ {W : X.Opens} {s : Γ(X, W)}
76	    (hreg : ∀ (y : X) (hy : y ∈ W),
77	      (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom s ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk y)) :
78	    s ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W) := by
79	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
80	  intro t ht
81	  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext X.sheaf W t 0
82	  intro y hy
83	  rw [map_zero]
84	  have key : (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom t * (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom s = 0 := by
85	    rw [← map_mul, ht, map_zero]
86	  exact (mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff (hreg y hy)).mp key
87	
88	/-- **Mutual divisibility against a germwise-regular section is a unit ratio**: if
89	`s = c₁ · t` and `t = c₂ · s` with every germ of `s` a nonzerodivisor, then `c₁` is a
90	unit, so `s = u · t` — the ratio-unit engine of the local-generator construction. -/
91	theorem exists_unit_mul_of_mutual_dvd {W : X.Opens} {s t c₁ c₂ : Γ(X, W)}
92	    (hreg : ∀ (y : X) (hy : y ∈ W),
93	      (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom s ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk y))
94	    (h₁ : s = c₁ * t) (h₂ : t = c₂ * s) :
95	    ∃ u : Γ(X, W)ˣ, s = (u : Γ(X, W)) * t := by
96	  have hzero : (1 - c₁ * c₂) * s = 0 := by
97	    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, ← h₂, ← h₁, sub_self]
98	  have hone : c₁ * c₂ = 1 := by
99	    have h := (mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff
100	      (sections_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_germ hreg)).mp hzero
101	    rwa [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h
102	  exact ⟨Units.mkOfMulEqOne c₁ c₂ hone, h₁⟩
103	
104	end GermRegular
105	
106	/-! ## The pinned chart of a side and the side-uniform theta components -/
107	
108	section Sides
109	
110	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
111	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
112	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
113	
114	/-- The pinned chart of a side: `V₀ᴿ` for `false`, `V₁ᴿ` for `true`. -/
115	noncomputable def relPinnedChart : Bool → (relCurve C R).Opens
116	  | false => (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
117	  | true => (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
118	
119	@[simp]
120	lemma relPinnedChart_false :
121	    relPinnedChart C R π false = (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ := rfl
122	
123	@[simp]
124	lemma relPinnedChart_true :
125	    relPinnedChart C R π true = (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := rfl
126	
127	/-- Both pinned charts are affine. -/
128	lemma isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart (b : Bool) : IsAffineOpen (relPinnedChart C R π b) := by
129	  cases b
130	  · exact relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)
131	  · exact relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)
132	
133	/-- **Flatness of the pinned chart sections over the test ring**: `Γ(C_R, Vᵢᴿ)` is the
134	free base change `R ⊗[k] Γ(C, Vᵢ)` (`free_relSections`), hence flat. -/
135	theorem flat_sections_relPinnedChart (b : Bool) :
136	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) := by
137	  cases b
138	  · haveI : Module.Free R Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π false) :=
139	      free_relSections C R (fiberChart₀ π)
140	        (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0).isCompact
141	        (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0).isQuasiSeparated
142	    exact Module.Flat.of_free
143	  · haveI : Module.Free R Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π true) :=
144	      free_relSections C R (fiberChart₁ π)
145	        (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1).isCompact
146	        (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1).isQuasiSeparated
147	    exact Module.Flat.of_free
148	
149	variable {C R π}
150	variable (a : ℕ)
151	
152	/-- **The side-uniform chart component of a global theta section**, restricted into an
153	open below the pinned chart of the side: `relThetaResFst` on side `false`,
154	`relThetaResSnd` on side `true`. -/
155	noncomputable def relThetaResSide :
156	    ∀ (b : Bool) {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}, W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π b →
157	      (relThetaSections C R π a →ₗ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, W))
158	  | false, _, hW => relThetaResFst a (le_inf le_top hW)
159	  | true, _, hW => relThetaResSnd a (le_inf le_top hW)
160	
161	@[simp]
162	lemma relThetaResSide_false {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
163	    (hW : W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π false) (x : relThetaSections C R π a) :
164	    relThetaResSide a false hW x = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_top hW) x.val.1 := rfl
165	
166	@[simp]
167	lemma relThetaResSide_true {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
168	    (hW : W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π true) (x : relThetaSections C R π a) :
169	    relThetaResSide a true hW x = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_top hW) x.val.2 := rfl
170	
171	/-- The side components commute with restriction. -/
172	lemma resHom_relThetaResSide (b : Bool) {W W' : (relCurve C R).Opens}
173	    (hW : W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π b) (h' : W' ≤ W) (x : relThetaSections C R π a) :
174	    (relCurve C R).resHom h' (relThetaResSide a b hW x)
175	      = relThetaResSide a b (h'.trans hW) x := by
176	  cases b <;> exact Scheme.resHom_resHom _ _ _
177	
178	/-- **The matching unit of an ordered pair of sides** on an open below both pinned
179	charts: `1` on equal sides, the theta cocycle (resp. its inverse) across the charts. -/
180	noncomputable def relThetaSideUnit :
181	    ∀ (b b' : Bool) {W : (relCurve C R).Opens},
182	      W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π b ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b' → Γ(relCurve C R, W)ˣ
183	  | false, false, _, _ => 1
184	  | false, true, _, hW => (relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hW (relThetaCocycle C R π a)
185	  | true, false, _, hW =>
186	      ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict
187	        (le_inf (hW.trans inf_le_right) (hW.trans inf_le_left))
188	        (relThetaCocycle C R π a))⁻¹
189	  | true, true, _, _ => 1
190	
191	/-- **The side matching law**: on an open below both pinned charts, the two side
192	components of a global theta section differ by the side matching unit
193	(`relThetaSections_matching` in side-uniform form). -/
194	lemma relThetaResSide_matching (b b' : Bool) {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
195	    (hW : W ≤ relPinnedChart C R π b ⊓ relPinnedChart C R π b')
196	    (x : relThetaSections C R π a) :
197	    relThetaResSide a b (hW.trans inf_le_left) x
198	      = (relThetaSideUnit a b b' hW : Γ(relCurve C R, W))
199	        * relThetaResSide a b' (hW.trans inf_le_right) x := by
200	  cases b <;> cases b'
201	  · rw [show relThetaSideUnit a false false hW = 1 from rfl, Units.val_one, one_mul]
202	  · exact relThetaSections_matching a x hW
203	  · have key := relThetaSections_matching a x
204	      (le_inf (hW.trans inf_le_right) (hW.trans inf_le_left))
205	    change relThetaResSide a true (hW.trans inf_le_left) x
206	        = ↑((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict
207	            (le_inf (hW.trans inf_le_right) (hW.trans inf_le_left))
208	            (relThetaCocycle C R π a))⁻¹
209	          * relThetaResSide a false (hW.trans inf_le_right) x
210	    rw [Units.eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq]
211	    exact key.symm
212	  · rw [show relThetaSideUnit a true true hW = 1 from rfl, Units.val_one, one_mul]
213	
214	end Sides
215	
216	end AlgebraicGeometry

21	`existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover`), the pic0/01JJ precedent.

45	noncomputable def divFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u where
46	  obj T := divFamZar C π n T.unop
47	  map g := ↾divFamZar.map C π n g.unop
48	  map_id T := by

51	  map_comp {T T' T''} g h := by
52	    ext s U
53	    exact congrArg (fun z : divFamZar C π n T''.unop => z.1 U)
54	      (divFamZar.map_comp C π n g.unop h.unop s)

57	lemma divFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
58	    (divFunctor C π n).obj T = divFamZar C π n T.unop :=
59	  rfl

63	    (s : divFamZar C π n T.unop) :
